faq.q: What is the Township of Langley's Official Community Plan?
faq.a: The Township's long-range policy plan, given effect through the Langley Official Community Plan Bylaw 1979 No. 1842 as amended — most recently by the 2025 OCP Update, Bylaw No. 6200, adopted December 1, 2025 — with component Community and Neighbourhood Plans providing area-specific policies under it

faq.q: Is this page a listing page?
faq.a: No: at reading it carried no MLS® listings or result count — it is an index of twelve Township community and neighbourhood plan tiles linking to tol.ca, covering Aldergrove, Brookswood-Fernridge, Willoughby, Murrayville and Walnut Grove among others

faq.q: How do the community plans interact with SSMUH?
faq.a: The plans set area policy while the zoning amendments do the permitting: Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) allows 3 units at ≤280 m² and 4 units at 280–4,050 m² on eligible lots, and an OCP Schedule 4 Development Permit Area for SSMUH form and character was adopted April 27, 2026
